annotations.annotation_text: Anna Livia Plurabelle (ALP), the archetypal feminine principle, mother, and personification of the River Liffey flowing through Dublin to the sea, manifested as "Anna Livia".
sources: Bishop, John. Joyce's Book of the Dark. https://archive.org/details/joycesbookofdark0000bish

annotations.annotation_text: Ancient Egyptian eschatology (set): HCE as the dismembered and resurrected god Osiris, ALP as Isis gathering his scattered limbs, and the dream journey through the underworld (Tuat).
sources: Budge, E.A. Wallis. The Book of the Dead (The Papyrus of Ani). https://www.gutenberg.org/ebooks/1300
Bishop, John. Joyce's Book of the Dark (The Egyptian Wake). https://archive.org/details/joycesbookofdark0000bish
